name: Upstox Read-Only Market Data V3 — RELIANCE Quality Pilot
lawful_access_basis: Private local research through the operator-owned Upstox account and read-only Analytics Token; no display, redistribution, alerts, orders, or trading.
fields: current NSE instrument and contract metadata for RELIANCE
current RELIANCE underlying and option best bid, best ask, quantities, open interest, and volume
provider timestamp, last-trade timestamp, local UTC receipt timestamp, and raw content hash
latency: Twenty request-time snapshots at sixty-second intervals during one approved market-hours pilot; no tick-level or executable-price claim.
collection_method: GET-only access to the NSE instrument master and Upstox V3 full-market-quote endpoint under an in-process host, method, path, and query allowlist.
retention_policy: Private local pilot storage only; maximum 250 MB; raw responses deleted after seven days; no cloud backup or external sharing.
